mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, which signals an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% and UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime characterized by rising new housing starts and strong retail sales, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past month indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the level of nonfarm payrolls falls below 135 million (135,000 thousand), it signals a contracting labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is below 135000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in new housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand and business investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 220, it indicates a high inflation environment that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
